summary: The main article describes the translation of a dual photoredox and nickel-catalyzed C(sp2)-C(sp3) cross-coupling reaction from batch to continuous flow, optimizing conditions for scalability and throughput. The article includes 4 tables detailing reaction screening, optimization, scope, and comparison, along with 1 figure illustrating the flow process. The experimental section provides characterization for 17 products.
